title: UI风格#197 - Japanese Minimal (日式极简)
description: 创建第197种UI风格：日式极简风格 - 日本美学、侘寂、书法、水墨。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planGO.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Japanese Minimal style When color palette Then features washi white, sumi black, indigo, vermillion
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 需要设计：#FAF5F0 (和纸白), #1A1A1A (墨黑), #2C3E50 (靛蓝), #D4380D (朱红)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Japanese Minimal style When typography Then uses japanese serif: Noto Serif JP, Shippori Mincho
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 字体选择：Noto Serif JP (日文), Shippori Mincho (书体)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Japanese Minimal style When layout Then asymmetric balance, ma (negative space), scroll composition
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 布局特点：不对称平衡、间（负空间）、卷轴构图

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Japanese Minimal style When UI elements Then ink wash, brush stroke, washi texture
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 交互特点：水墨渲染、毛笔笔触、和纸纹理

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Japanese Minimal UI When functional Then includes zen chat, bamboo agents, harmony stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 功能需求：禅意聊天、竹子代理、和谐统计

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Japanese Minimal UI When copy Then uses zen: 'Ma', 'Wabi', 'Sabi', 'Kanso'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 创意文案：标题'MA. WABI. SABI.'、按钮'SUBMIT'→'KANSO'、'DEPLOY'→'SHAKKEI'
